result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make it harder for people to pretend other people aren’t fully human.

Not by forcing kindness.  
By making it impossible to look at someone and genuinely see only a threat, a resource, a symbol, or an “other.”

That one change would probably fix most of the rest.
